description: Optional evidence: read a document the person chooses to share and return its text and origin, so you can propose statements from its passages for the person to affirm. Reads PDF, Word (.docx) and plain text; text your host has already read can be sent as pasted. Reading a document affirms nothing and verifies nothing.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64. A call's files total at most about 1.5 MB.

package.description: The package the last GoldSeam Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

label.description: What the text is, e.g. the file's name

name: read_my_document_for_selfie

documents.description: Each document's evidence_id, filename, slot, extraction_status and text

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it

problem.description: When status is needs_attention: code, statement, what_to_do

status.description: What happened, or needs_attention with a problem

title: Read My Document for Selfie
